title: Chapter 13 The Rain Keeps Falling
content:
Chapter 13 The Rain Keeps Falling

Comparatively speaking, Wang Shuo is certainly lucky.

Zhang Xiaojun, he was born in a snowy land. He was not successful in collecting materials. He only upgraded his shelter to a wooden house. At this moment, there was not much wood left in his backpack.

Every once in a while, the system prompted him to repair the wooden house. He had no tiles, so he could only keep adding wood.

The roof had begun to leak, and the ground corroded by acid rain made him a little scared. He knew that if the rain continued, he might not survive tonight.

…

Liu Feifei, she just used a "cotton coat production drawing" to exchange for 100 tiles to upgrade the stone house, but her stone was not enough. Looking at the acid rain dripping from the roof, she was now hesitating whether to use the only piece of rabbit meat in her hand to exchange for upgraded stone. She was still short of 20 units of stone, and she didn't even know if there would be kind people to exchange with her.

Even if she upgraded the stone house, if the acid rain continued, it would be difficult for her to collect food. She couldn't help crying, thinking of her grandparents, who loved Xiaofei the most.

...

This sudden acid rain has become a nightmare for countless players.

Many players kept praying in their hearts, hoping that the gods and Buddhas in the heavens could keep them safe, but this was doomed to be in vain. Only they themselves could save them!

...

The next morning, Wang Shuo opened his eyes and saw that he was still covered with a warm quilt, and he felt a little relieved.

The temperature of the earthen kang was much lower because the wooden sticks under the kang had been burned out.

The acid rain outside the house was still dripping, and every drop seemed to remind him that today was not a good day.

After getting up in the morning, he habitually opened the "Survivor's Handbook".

(Day 3, 7:21 AM, current area survival number: 5064/10000.)

After two days and two nights, half of the players were eliminated. Wang Shuo was not sure whether those eliminated players were really dead or just quit the game and returned to real life.

Although the mysterious voice had said that death here was real death.

But Wang Shuo still had some doubts, what if it was a lie!

But Wang Shuo turned his head and thought again, this mysterious power is so powerful, how could it care about human life!

Wang Shuo didn't dare to gamble, he could only try to keep himself alive!

[Side Quest]

1. Please upgrade the houses to residential houses as soon as possible.

(Upgrade conditions: 500 wood + 2000 bricks + 1000 tiles + 400 stones + 1 energy crystal.)

2. An elite crocodile appeared in your territory, please find and destroy it.

3. The first rain.

(This acid rain is a small test for you. Don't worry, the rain will stop.)

Seeing that the [Task Bar] has not changed, Wang Shuo tried hard to think of a countermeasure.

It seems that the crocodiles in the territory must be killed before the task is over, and this acid rain is a bit inexplicable. Is it just to increase the difficulty for the players?

There is also the upgrade of the shelter. No need to remind, Wang Shuo will also work hard to upgrade it. After all, he has tasted the sweetness from it.

At this time, the rumbling stomach reminded Wang Shuo that it was time to eat something.

Wang Shuo went to the kitchen, cooked a fish, and simmered rice in a pottery pot, and ate it deliciously.

After breakfast, the sky outside was bright. After upgrading the houses, every room had windows opened.

Wang Shuo came under the eaves and looked up at the sky. It was cloudy and rainy, and the fog was lingering. Outside the field of vision, it was still shrouded in fog.

It seems that the 50-meter range around Wang Shuo is like being contained in a well.

Wang Shuo suddenly thought of the well blueprint. Let's see if we can build the well today.

He opened the [Diary] again, and the content on it changed.

"My name is Wang Shuo. Today is the third day since I came to this strange foggy world. It has been raining acid outside. I feel a little heavy when I think that I can't go out to collect supplies. Anyway, I'm idle, so I stepped into the third room and started a day of making tools.

In my spare time, I started to brush the [chat channel].

On the fourth day, it rained, brushed the channel.

On the fifth day, it rained, brushed the channel.

On the sixth day, it rained, brushed the channel.

On the seventh day, Wang Shuo, Wang Shuo, you can't be decadent. Don't you have to work when it rains? There is not much rice left. If you don't work hard to find a way, do you want to starve to death?

On the eighth day, save some rice and you can still hold on for a few more days. It rains, brushes the channel.

On the ninth day, it rains, brushes the channel.

..."

"What the hell?" Wang Shuo was shocked.

He was afraid. If it kept raining, he would be like this forever, and then... nothing would happen?

Wang Shuo found that reading this "diary" was really terrifying. The information inside was true and false, which made Wang Shuo feel uneasy.

With an uneasy mood, he stepped into the third room.

[Tool bench and forging bench can be built. After construction, more "synthesis formulas" can be unlocked. ]

[Tool bench: wood 440/10, stone 540/5, iron ore 200/10]

[Build it? ]

"Yes."

[Wood -10, stone -5, construction time 10 minutes. ]

He checked the production formula of the "forging bench" again.

[Forging bench: stone 535/20, iron ore 190/50]

[Build it? ]

"Yes."

[Stone-20, iron ore-50, construction time 10 minutes. 】

…

[After the tool table is built and the residence is upgraded, the second-level tool table can be upgraded. 】

[After the construction of the forging platform is completed, the "furnace" is unlocked. After upgrading the courtyard, it can be upgraded to a blacksmith shop. 】

[Smelting Furnace: Iron Ore 140/100]

[Build or not? 】

"yes."

[Iron Ore -100, construction time 30 minutes. 】

Not long after, there were two chopping board-like objects beside the two walls of the workshop.

[Because you built the tool bench, there is a new "synthetic formula" unlocked, please check it yourself. 】

Wang Shuo walked in and took a look. In front of him was a two-square-meter platform with a smooth wooden surface. It was obviously the "tool table" prompted by the system. There were various types of knives, drills, drills, and scissors on it. There were many tools, many of which Wang Shuo could not name or understand their uses.

The other platform is much simpler. On a one-meter-square iron pier, there is a big hammer and a small hammer next to it.

After a while, the system prompt sounded again:

[The furnace is constructed. 】

[Since you built the forging table and furnace: Unlock the "synthesis formula" of basic iron tools, please check it yourself. 】

[10 sickles: 1 branch + 1 iron ore]

There are many more below, hoes, iron picks, plows, iron axes...

Most of them were basic farm tools, but there were still things that made Wang Shuo's eyes shine.

[Iron ax: 1 wooden stick + 1 iron ingot]

(Ordinary iron ax, white quality, attack +10, durability 10/10, equipment requirements: none.)

(Tree-cutting artifact, when you chop down a big tree, holding an iron ax, you may want to yell: "Who else?" But don't put too much hope in it, it can't break the elite crocodile defense, but you can still fight against ordinary beasts.)

[Plain knife: 1 hemp rope + 1 iron ingot]

[100 arrow clusters: 1 iron ingot]

[10 (iron) arrows = 1 wooden stick + 10 arrow clusters + 1 feather]

[Wooden bow: 1 wooden stick + 1 hemp rope]

(Ordinary wooden bow, white quality, attack +5, durability 10/10, equipment requirements: none.)

Seeing these weapon synthesis formulas, Wang Shuo finally smiled.

He quickly made the remaining iron ore into iron ingots.

[Iron Ore -40, Iron Ingot +4]

Since he already had a sophisticated spear, he planned to make an iron axe, a simple sword and a wooden bow, and 100 arrows.

Standing in the workshop, I silently thought "making" in my mind.

Not long after, these weapons were lying in Wang Shuo's backpack.

Taking out the iron ax, I instantly felt my body was full of power, and I couldn't help but want to yell: "Who else is there?"

The room was too small and some of them couldn't be used, so he didn't take out other weapons to try out his skills.
